statement: Every intermediate exponent-prime Heisenberg cover has both all-prime cusp assertions
notes: Registered after full root and DE proof/source/certificate audits PASS. New intermediate type is the quotient by a noncentral order-p subgroup, of degree p², genus 1+p(p−1)/2 and p cusps. At ordinary p choose the Gaussian place where its translation line is étale, yielding a free special quotient preserving rational cusp paths. At inert p, resolution of the actual quotient morphism and domination of every positive component gives one radicial main and no other positive component over O; compact type and the p cusps then give rational joining paths. A42 supplies actual all-prime fixedness, A59 normalizers. This includes every two-generated geometric closure of exponent p and class at most two, but not all nilpotent closures or the universal question.
